profile.headline: Pursuing Java Software Engineer roles in August 2026 - JavaScript, TypeScript, Java*, Python, Node.js, Spring, Microservices, REST API, Docker, AWS
profile.summary:
In middle school, I was utterly enchanted by the world of MySpace layouts and their mysterious inner workings. I spent hours upon hours tinkering with various layouts, playfully breaking them down into basic code fragments. It was mind-boggling how just a few lines of code could conjure up scrolling text, transform backgrounds, and set pictures in motion with the click of a mouse.
.
Little did I realize at the time that coding was more than just a pastime; it was my calling—a chance to unravel complex problems and unleash my creativity simultaneously. As I stepped into high school, the path became clearer, and I knew that a career in software development was my destined journey. 
.
Fast-forward to today. With a decade of experience in the field, I've come a long way from those early MySpace explorations. Yet, the passion for coding that ignited back then still burns brightly within me.
.
.
.

projects.title: E-Shopping: Product Dashboard
projects.description:
Project objective: To create REST API service using Spring Boot framework that provides functionality to add, update, and fetch products.

REST API should implement the following functionalities:
---------------------------------------------------
1) Add a product using POST request at /products
    - If a product with the same ID already exists, then the HTTP response code should be 400. Otherwise, the response code should be 201.

2) Update a product by id using PUT request at /products/{product_id}
    - If the product with the requested ID does not exist, return HTTP response code 400. Otherwise, return HTTP response code 200.

3) Return product by id using GET request at /products/{product_id}
    - If a product with the requested ID does not exist, the HTTP response code should be 404. Otherwise, the response code should be 200.

4) Return JSON array of all products by the given category using GET request at /products?category={category}.
    - HTTP response should be 200
    - JSON array should be sorted by availability. Meaning in-stock products must be listed before out-of-stock products.
    - Products with the same availability must be sorted by discount price in ascending order
    - Products with the same discount price must be sorted by ID in ascending order
	
5) Return JSON array of all products by the given category and availability using GET request at /products?category={category}&availability={availability}.
    - HTTP response should be 200
    - JSON array should be sorted by discount percentage in descending order
    - Products with the same discount percentage status must be sorted by discount price in ascending order.
    - Products with the same discount price must be sorted by ID in ascending order
   Note: Discount percentage is always an integer
   
6) Return JSON array of all products using GET request at /products
    - The HTTP response code should be 200
    - The JSON array should be sorted by the ID in ascending order.

projects.title: Smart TV Virtual keyboard
projects.description:
Program Objective: how many button presses does it take to input a given word?

Remote: directional keys (up, down, left, right), center select button

The layout of our on-screen keyboard:
a  b  c  d  e  f  g  h  i
j  k  l  m  n  o  p  q  r
s  t  u  v  w  x  y  z  DONE

Rules:
Our cursor is controlled by 5 input buttons: left, right, up, down, and select.
The keyboard loads with the cursor at the ‘a’ character.
The cursor can only move horizontally or vertically, not diagonally.
To finalize the input text and dismiss the keyboard, we must select the DONE key at the end.

pastPositions.title: Java Software Engineer
pastPositions.description:
Delivered a multi‑tenant SaaS healthcare platform using React.js, Java 21, Spring Boot, and REST API.
Engineered REST pipelines with Gateway routing, Kafka events, and gRPC calls, increasing API consistency and performance.
Constructed controller‑service‑repository pipelines with valid DTOs and models, strengthening domain logic.
Improved throughput using virtual threads, Redis locks, and parallel gRPC calls, preventing data conflicts and boosting parallel event processing.
Built global exception error workflows for JWT, validation, and billing failures, reducing client‑facing errors and stabilizing services.
Built scalable storage using RDS PostgreSQL, S3, and Redis caching, optimizing query paths and ensuring strong consistency for clinical records.
Optimized runtime on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service with autoscaling, improving performance and reducing compute overhead.
Implemented JUnit, Mockito, REST Assured, and k6 load tests to ensure reliability, coverage, and regression stability.
Led code reviews focused on security, performance, and test coverage, raising code quality across all microservices.
Built CI/CD pipelines and deployment flows using GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform.
Delivered end‑to‑end tracing and metrics pipelines using OpenTelemetry Java Agent for auto‑instrumentation, Micrometer for application metrics (Spring Boot), Amazon Managed Prometheus for metrics storage and scraping, and Grafana for dashboards and visualization.
Implemented centralized logging with Logback via Simple Logging Facade for Java as the primary logging implementation and Grafana Loki as the log storage backend.
Configured AMP, Loki, & Tempo alerting pipelines with PagerDuty.

React.js, Material User Interface (MUI), React Router, Redux Toolkit, OAuth 2.0, Keycloak, JWT, Java, Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate ORM, JPA (Java Persistence API), REST API, gRPC, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Postgres, Microservices, Apache Tomcat, Git, GitHub

positions.title: C# Software Engineer
positions.description:
Varec Hackathon Project Objective: 
• Initiate and implement a Continuous Integration and Delivery (CI/CD) pipeline for Varec.

Importance of the Project: 
• Establishing a CI/CD pipeline was crucial to enhance Varec's software development processes by making them more flexible, standardized, efficient, and less prone to errors.

Technologies Utilized: 
• Team Foundation Version Control (TFVC), Git Migration, Microsoft Team Foundation Server (TFS), Jira, Bitbucket, FinalBuilder, Bamboo Server, and Configuration and setup of test servers.

Accomplishments:
• Automated the merging process where code changes, once approved, were automatically merged to the master branch.
• Established an automated build process that triggered upon successful code merge to the master branch, followed by automatic deployment, ensuring continuous delivery and integration.
• Installed and configured the Bitbucket Server, and executed the Git migration to Bitbucket, ensuring a seamless transition.
• Integrated Jira and Bamboo with Bitbucket, creating a cohesive and efficient workflow.
• Successfully migrated multiple branches, including the Main branch, from TFVC to Git, streamlining version control.

positions.title: Taleo System Administrator
positions.description:
• Lead Taleo administrator supporting General Motors' global full‑cycle recruiting operations across 20 countries.
• Served as the primary liaison between Talent Acquisition & IT across 20+ countries, functioning as a trusted advisor & strategic partner to internal users' “client accounts”, including HR, Engineering, & recruiting leadership for full‑cycle recruiting support & all recruiting system needs.
• Managed daily operational processes and provided direct support to over 400 recruiters, HMs, HR, Talent Acquisition, & recruiting leadership, resolving 95% of support tickets within the established SLA, ensuring consistent internal & external user satisfaction & continuous system functionality.
• Conducted 30+ Taleo training sessions & quarterly business reviews with internal users (HR, HMs, Recruiters) to drive adoption of new features, optimize workflows, & ensure alignment with evolving business needs.
• Identified, proposed & implemented recruiting pipeline improvements to centralize candidate data, track all interactions, create email sequences, follow-ups, manage diversity engagement efforts, improve operational efficiency, provide comprehensive analytics, & improve coordination between recruiters, HMs, & team members – delivering overall end-to-end comprehensive HR & talent lifecycle management.
• Translated 300+ business requirements into actionable configuration specifications, demonstrating the ability to uncover user or client pain points, propose tailored solutions, & drive adoption.
• Maintained global full-cycle recruiting process, including requisition templates, career sites for countries across 3+ continents, user-defined forms, candidate experience workflows, hiring manager processes to improve time‑to‑submit/time-to-fill & overall pipeline health.
• Orchestrated 2-week sprint cycles to guide stakeholders through scoping, prioritization, & delivery expectations, facilitated daily scrum meetings for IT teams based in the United States & Argentina.
